title: The desk's core cap reaches bats alone: DEVBIN_TEST_JOBS bounds the suite and nothing reaches a project's build commands
body:
## Summary

**The desk's core cap reaches bats alone.** `DEVBIN_TEST_JOBS` bounds `bin/devbin test all` (bin/.devbin/help/test.md: N is half the CPUs unless set), and nothing else in the core or in the project command contract reads a cap: a project's build and test commands that run cargo or xcodebuild take their parallelism from the tool's own default, the whole machine. A shared desk that grants a run "under a 4-core cap" has no knob to make a `no_args` project command honour it.

## Measured

2026-10-31, Intent's estate on rhadamanth: Intent's `bin/devbin macos app-test`, a project-declared command under devbin's `no_args` contract, builds its xcodebuild line internally with no `-jobs` and no environment passthrough (Intent's dc read it at Intent e449dfa2e). The desk could cap Intent's cargo build through `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4` only because cargo reads that variable itself; the xcodebuild run had to be issued by hand with `-jobs 4` to honour the cap, a deviation from the judge leg as the package names it. Devbin's own suite is capped by `DEVBIN_TEST_JOBS`, and under its default of half the CPUs the fork-heavy suite pushed rhadamanth's one-minute load average above 100 while another estate's build waited.

## Recommendation

One knob, read in one place. `DEVBIN_JOBS` is the desk's cap: `test` takes it as `DEVBIN_TEST_JOBS`'s default, the `build:` block (WP16) exports it to every build it runs as `CARGO_BUILD_JOBS` and as xcodebuild's `-jobs`, and the project command contract names it in the environment a declared command inherits, so a project command can honour it without a flag. Low: the desk grants by hand today and a controller who sees the load can hold a run; the fix lands with WP16's `build:` block, after the 0.1.19 cut.

Resolution (cc, 2026-11-05 06:02Z by date -u): fixed in part at 2769325b4959b37b83f06c55c445b40aabd6654b, landed on main by devbin-vc's land-stack.sh from the tested tip f7105c53, as run over code main gained since its base, none of it this unit's, unpushed until the 0.1.20 cut; the rest closed unfixed, as no project can reach it. bats-lanes (bin/.devbin/cmd/.lib), DEVBIN_TEST_JOBS's one reader, now reads DEVBIN_TEST_JOBS, else DEVBIN_JOBS, the one knob a shared desk sets: the suite takes it where its own setting is unset, which still wins, and the first line and every refusal name the variable read. bin/.devbin/help/test.md says so, and docs/authoring-commands.md lists DEVBIN_JOBS in the environment a declared command inherits, so a project's build or test command can bound its own tools by it, cargo's CARGO_BUILD_JOBS or xcodebuild's -jobs, with no flag; nothing exports it, since it reaches a command as any inherited variable does. The issue's third part, the build: block exporting the cap to every build it runs, is closed unfixed at vc's ruling: the core reads the block and caches its artefacts but runs no build through it yet, so no project can reach it, and the first runner of the block exports it. The arm, in testhandler.bats: under six CPUs, DEVBIN_JOBS sets the parallel lane's N and the first line names it, DEVBIN_TEST_JOBS wins where both are set, and a DEVBIN_JOBS that is no whole number is refused by name; lanes_run clears DEVBIN_JOBS with the rest. Its run, under hv's rule that a fix runs its own arms alone (decision 138), in slot 01M6N4JJ73GAAJB4VYH4BBY7V2 on devbin-vc's desk at f7105c53 on 3d3cc1bf: the arm red at main's code with the unit's testhandler.bats, main reading no DEVBIN_JOBS, and, with the four lanes arms whose words now come from the variable read, green at the tip under BSD, 5 ok of 5. The cut's own gates, kovacs leg and CI are the one full test.
